comment: Development-toolchain advisories the release check may pass while they stand. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry fails the check. An entry with onlyVia also fails, on every run, as soon as the package is reachable from any other direct dependency or is not dev-only (resolved from package-lock.json); such entries may run 180 days, others 45. Production (npm audit --omit=dev) has no exceptions.

exceptions.reason: No patched braces release exists (<=3.0.3 is every version; the advisory is stack exhaustion from deeply nested patterns). It reaches the toolchain only through eslint-config-next (@next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch), which expands this repository's own lint patterns, never request input. onlyVia makes the check fail if that ever changes. Remove when braces publishes a fix or the Next.js ESLint plugin drops fast-glob.
